subject.title: feat(hooks): add ACP turn transcript save hook

question: Should OpenClaw add a supported `agent:turn:transcript:save` internal hook contract and move ACP transcript persistence into the awaited save boundary?
rationale: The code path is coherent, but the new hook surface and save-ordering semantics become product/API behavior that automation should not approve without owner intent.

options.title: Sponsor rebased hook
options.body: Accept the product/API direction, require the registry repair and current-head proof, then review for merge.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Keep the PR open but ask for a smaller event/order contract before it becomes an internal API surface.

options.title: Close as unsponsored
options.body: Close this PR if maintainers do not want to own a transcript-save durability hook now.

recommendation.title: Sponsor rebased hook
recommendation.body: Accept the product/API direction, require the registry repair and current-head proof, then review for merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the internal hook system and recently refactored the ACP turn-runner boundary this PR changes.
